{{nihongo|'''Takihira Shrine'''|嶽比良神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Takihira Shrine''' (takihira-jinja, takehira-jinja) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Miyake, Tokyo|ca|Miyake|es|Miyake (Tokio)|fa|میاکه، توکیو|fi|Miyake (Tokio)|fr|Miyake (Tokyo)|hy|Միյաքե (գյուղ)|id|Miyake, Tōkyō|it|Miyake (Tokyo)|ja|三宅村|ko|미야케촌|ru|Мияке (село)|th|มิยาเกะ (โตเกียว)|uk|Міяке (Токіо)|uz|Miyake (Tokio)|zh|三宅村|zh_yue|三宅村|qid=Q1154797}} ({{ill|Miyake-jima|ar|مياكي جيما|ast|Miyakejima|az|Miyakecima|ceb|Miyake Jima|cs|Mijakedžima|de|Miyake-jima|eo|Mijakeŝimo|es|Miyakejima|fa|میاکجیما|fr|Miyake-jima|it|Miyakejima|ja|三宅島|ko|미야케섬|lt|Mijakedžima|pnb|میاک-جیما|pt|Ilha Miyake|ru|Мияке (остров)|sk|Mijakedžima|sv|Miyakejima|th|เกาะมิยาเกะ|tl|Miyake, Tokyo|tr|Miyakejima|uk|Міяке (острів)|vi|Miyakejima|zh|三宅島|qid=Q1075076}}), {{ill|Tokyo|Q1490|qid=Q1490}}<ref name="engi-chosa">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140118-01.html 嶽比良神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref><ref>[https://info.gbiz.go.jp/hojin/ichiran?hojinBango=5010005009460 嶽比良神社] - 経済産業省</ref>.

The shrine is situated near the summit of Takenohira (also read Takinohira) Mountain, in the mountains of the Izu district in the northwestern part of Miyakejima, east of {{ill|Gosai-jinjna|ja|御祭神社|qid=Q131925937}}.

It is identified as '''Yasunomikoto Shrine''' (yasunomikoto-jinja), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} dedicated to Yasu no Mikoto, the third child among the eight princes born to {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} (Mishima Daimyōjin) and his consort Sakitamahime no Mikoto (the enshrined deity of {{ill|Oshaku Shrine|ja|御笏神社|qid=Q110915859}}), who is known as "Yasu." However, another Ronsha candidate is the Ontake Shrine, which was merged into {{ill|Ninomiya Shrine (Q134930277)|ja|二宮神社 (三宅村)|qid=Q134930277|lt=Ninomiya Shrine}} in the Tsubota district<ref name="engi-chosa"/><ref name="miyake">[https://www.soumu.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/14miyake/miyakehp/kankousasshi_0503.pdf 三宅島 p.84] - 東京都/三宅島観光協会</ref><ref name="jyr">[https://jun-yu-roku.com/shrine/engishiki/izu/ 伊豆國 九十二座] - 神社巡遊録</ref><ref>''{{ill|Miyakeki|ja|三宅記|qid=Q17215100}}''</ref>.
